stopping_rules: Each schedule has exactly one1600-update attempt, at most300 seconds; no scientific retry.
Unsupported CUDA host blocks before training; no CPU fallback.
Nonfinite values, exceptions or timeout remain explicit incomplete/error outcomes.
Do not stop at first acquisition: finish the declared budget unless safety/nonfinite/timeout failure.
Do not run a hold, seed sweep, threshold grid or promotion automatically.
